note: Neutral scenes only. No photos, no real people, no customer content. Characters are described in text (photoIds stay empty). Names are invented. Styles are GreetHub style ids from docs/design/style-library.json. Not yet runnable end to end: the identity stage requires photos (see docs/PLAN.md, Model evals).

rubric.scale: Each dimension 1-5 per page, scored by a human (and later a calibrated judge). 5 = print-ready, 3 = acceptable with a small flaw, 1 = must re-roll. Hard checks are pass/fail.

hard_checks.count: Exactly the cast listed for the page; no extra or duplicated figures.
hard_checks.border: Full bleed; no white or cream frame on any edge.
hard_checks.text: No letters, numbers or words in the art.
hard_checks.ip: No protected character, logo, slogan or licensed print; look-alike risk below 6.

dimensions.consistency: Each character matches the model sheet: face, hair, outfit colours and cut. 5 = same character; 1 = a different person.
dimensions.anatomy: Bodies, limbs and faces are whole and plausible for the style. 1 = extra or missing limbs, merged bodies.
dimensions.teeth: Smiles match the sheet (full row stays a full row, closed stays closed). 1 = gaps, extra rows, distorted mouths.
dimensions.hands: Five fingers, natural grip on props. 1 = fused, extra or missing fingers in view.
dimensions.framing: All cast fully in frame with about 12% margin; text zone calm when asked. 1 = heads or hands cut off, text zone busy.
dimensions.style_fidelity: Matches the chosen style's description and avoid-list. 1 = reads as a different style.

rubric.per_item_verdict: would_pay: yes/no (would a buyer accept this page without a re-roll)
